video.title: Jim Rohn: Why Not You, Why Not Now

motivational.video_read: This is Jim Rohn on stage at a Herbalife 'Extravaganza', delivering his famous four-questions talk: why, why not, why not you, why not now. The motivational material lives exactly in those question builds — the 'why not you' passage is the most-commented moment in the video, and the audience quotes the 'why/how' and 'without a vision' lines verbatim. Herbalife product pitches thread through and contaminate several stretches (especially the 'why not now' build), which I have worked around rather than through.

near_misses.why_not: The 'why pay the price, why work this hard' roll is genuinely strong but runs ~95 seconds to its landing ('you're the only one that can answer that question for yourself'), and its best quotable payoff is already captured in the L0014-L0016 clip.

'If a farm boy can wander out of Idaho... why not you' is a good reframe, but it leans on Extravaganza and 'Mar Hughes' references a stranger can't read, and it duplicates the stronger 'why not you' clip at L0049.

The 'why not now' question itself is one of the famous four, but the moment it opens it collapses into a Herbalife mountain-top recap ('Barcelona was special, Orlando was outrageous') — unusable around the question.

skipped.what: movie testimony ('we joined because we believed, we left because we were disillusioned') — context-dependent, no turn for the viewer
dream-strategy setup that becomes a Herbalife product pitch ('herbal life has got the ability to make it all come true')
Rohn's own goals dated to the year 2000 — someone else's résumé, dated and unusable
warm 'I wish I could sit with each of you' passage — affection, not motivation
'I'll walk with you as we take Herbal Life around the world' — sponsor pledge

clips.title: Why not you?
clips.description: Jim Rohn turns a speech into a direct personal confrontation: 'my personal question to you is why not you' — then builds the case ('you've got the brains... you can build a financial wall around your family nothing can get through') and lands the question twice more. It removes the viewer's quiet excuse that they are not the kind of person things happen to.
clips.boundary_note: Moved the start off L0049's mid-sentence 'do it from up here' onto the hook question 'my personal question to you is why not you' — question-first, no dangling references. Moved the end off the finder's 'why not you but' (ending on a dangling 'but') to close on the final 'I ask the question why not you', cutting before the Herbalife tail. Kept the pledge sentence as the coda between the two landings.

clips.title: Why not see what kind of person you can become
clips.description: Jim Rohn's permission roll — 'Why not? Why not see how much you can earn, why not see how much you can learn, why not see what kind of person you can become…' — strips away the assumption that wanting more needs a justification, and lands on 'why not see how many people you can reach.'

clips.title: Why not now? There never was a better time.
clips.description: A closing rally cry built on the viewer's own question — 'why not now?' — that turns a dream into an instruction: take it, give it life, breathe into it your own personal spirit until finally it becomes a flame that burns around the whole world. It ends on the only command that matters: let's go do it now.
clips.boundary_note: Moved the start back to the question 'why not now' (L0056) per the question rule, and used a second segment to splice out the Herbalife/Extravaganza recap (L0057-L0060 first half) that sits between question and payoff; both joins sit at sentence boundaries ('...a better time' -> 'take this dream'), the prescribed cut-in 'take this dream and not let it die' is kept, and the end stays on the landing 'let's go do it now'.

clips.title: If the why is powerful, the how is easy — without a dream we're nothing
clips.description: A leadership-training lesson delivered in two beats: "if the why is powerful, the how is easy," then the escalation into the old prophet's warning — "without a vision we die, without a vision we perish, without a dream we're nothing." Both lines are quoted verbatim in viewer comments, and the second one lands flat and final, which is exactly where the clip should stop.
clips.boundary_note: Moved the start one word forward: the finder opened on the orphan 'why' that finishes the previous sentence ('a strong enough why'), a mid-sentence start. 'In leadership training here's what we learn' is the true sentence start and loses nothing — the clip introduces 'the why' itself seconds later. Kept the close at 'without a dream we're nothing'; the movie-quote thread in L0017–L0018 is a separate moment.

step1.title: If the why is powerful, the how is easy
step1.why: Two separate quotable lines delivered back to back: the mechanism ('if the why is powerful the how is easy') and the warning ('without a vision we die, without a vision we perish, without a dream we're nothing'). Both lines are quoted word-for-word in the audience's comments — one at 93 likes saying they have listened to this speech over 100 times. The first line hands the viewer a way to think about their own stuckness; the second makes the absence of a dream feel existential. Under 22 seconds total, and either line can be flashed at the head of the reel.
